title: Experiment #6 - Wake Up
description: A minecraft horror pack with two goals (one optional), Either Beat the Game or Survive
body:
# Wake Up
This is a horror modpack for 1.20.1 + Forge.

- The experience centers around the Reverox and the core concept of waking up, and While this pack is best played with no prior knowledge of the included mods to preserve the horror elements, it is built for players who enjoy having tension while playing survival and being able to use their mic (Simple Voice Chat).

## Key Features
-  Voice Mimicry (Reverox): Features a monster that listens to your microphone and plays back clips of your voice to your friends to lure them. (Mic required for this mod to function fully).
Combat and Structures: DarkSouls-like mobs and structures are integrated to provide difficult encounters and exploration.
- Collectibles: Includes My Little Pony plushies as rare collectibles + abilities

## Requirements
RAM: Minimum 4GB allocated, 6GB recommended for optimal performance.
Microphone: For Reverox to work with you, You'd be in the need of a microphone so that the monster can copy the clip and scare your friends

Goal: Either reach the end-game or focus purely on survival.
